senses.gloss: pr. n. (Βιθυνία) Bithynia, a province in the N. W. of Asia Minor.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 37">Gen. R. s. 37</cite>, beg. (misplaced, v. <cite ref="A00784"><he>אוסיא</he></cite>); Y. Meg. I, 71ᵇ bot. (<cite ref="Yoma 10a:2">Yoma 10ᵃ</cite> <he>בית אונייקי</he>).
